name: header
description: Sticky site header: text wordmark Jack Jin, four nav links (Technical Writing, Portfolio, Talks, Certifications), Light/Dark/System theme control; folds behind a Menu toggle below 1024px.
rationale: 34/34 pages, one fingerprint. Boilerplate header loads /nav as a fragment; parity needs the three-zone layout, the 44px targets, the current-page rule and the theme control, so it is the boilerplate header with site CSS and a tools section.

variants.rationale: 34/34 pages, one fingerprint. Boilerplate header loads /nav as a fragment; parity needs the three-zone layout, the 44px targets, the current-page rule and the theme control, so it is the boilerplate header with site CSS and a tools section.

name: footer
description: Compact one-row footer: copyright with city and four profile links.
rationale: 34/34 pages, one fingerprint. Boilerplate footer fragment as-is structurally; the single compact row is CSS.

variants.rationale: 34/34 pages, one fingerprint. Boilerplate footer fragment as-is structurally; the single compact row is CSS.

name: section-style
description: Full-bleed section band: the section-metadata Style word sets the ground (plain, alt, tint, inverse) and an optional accent word keys the tint.
rationale: EDS section metadata is built in; the band classes become section classes. 16 bands on the 5 non-article pages. Articles and the portfolio do not use bands.

variants.rationale: Style: alt (Paper Alt ground), the closing note bands. 3 bands.
Style: plain (Paper ground). 12 bands.
Style: tint (+ accent word), the home Selected work band. 1 band.

name: hero
description: Page opening: breadcrumb where present, the serif title, then the page's lede. The home, writing, talks and certifications heroes carry the ambient canvas (page-art.js) behind the copy.
rationale: One block on all 34 pages with five content shapes. None of the source heroes has a background picture, so the boilerplate hero renders none of them as-is; each variant is the boilerplate hero cell model (heading, text, buttons) plus a variant class and CSS. The canvas is decoration added by code, never authored.

variants.rationale: 28 articles: breadcrumb, title, mono byline (author, date, updated, read time, video length), summary; three articles add a series nav (Part 1/2/3). Byline values come from page metadata.
Display title, three-line positioning with an italic last line, summary, one primary button and a text link; the champion proof list sits beside it (proof-list).
Writing, talks, certifications: breadcrumb, display title, one-line summary over the ambient canvas.
Privacy: breadcrumb and display title only.
Portfolio: kicker, title, deck, primary button, featured links over its own signal-field and glow (portfolio/script.js).

name: proof-list
description: Hero aside of dated facts: the Adobe Champion badge image, three rows (link + dated note), a View all link.
rationale: Home only. It is the canon proof list (label + dated value rows) with a badge image on top; no reference block lays out a ruled definition list.

variants.rationale: The badge image variant on the home hero.

name: breadcrumb
description: Home / Section / Page trail in mono 12px; separators drawn by CSS.
rationale: On 32/34 pages (inside the hero on articles, in the hub band elsewhere). Derived from the path and page title, so code builds it; authors never type it.

variants.rationale: On 32/34 pages (inside the hero on articles, in the hub band elsewhere). Derived from the path and page title, so code builds it; authors never type it.

name: showcase
description: Text column beside a media column (frame, panel, deck, timeline); flip puts media first from 768px, wide stacks centered text over full-width media.
rationale: Two cells, text and media, is the columns model; parity needs the showcase CSS (serif title with an italic accent phrase, mono meta, lead) and the band-accent rule. On the portfolio a story often holds a block of its own (frame, diagram deck, carousel, ladder, stat chips, flow); EDS blocks do not nest, so those stay their own rows next to the showcase (nested_in in page-blocks).

variants.rationale: Two cells, text and media, is the columns model; parity needs the showcase CSS (serif title with an italic accent phrase, mono meta, lead) and the band-accent rule. On the portfolio a story often holds a block of its own (frame, diagram deck, carousel, ladder, stat chips, flow); EDS blocks do not nest, so those stay their own rows next to the showcase (nested_in in page-blocks).
Home Selected work: Anima Mesh text beside a diagram frame.
adaptTo() 2026 recap: 25 talks, each a slide image beside notes.
Portfolio story whose media is another block.

name: row-list
description: Hairline-ruled rows: a mono kind or date column, a linked title, a short note; the talks variant adds an event line and links.
rationale: Related list closing all 28 articles, the 9-row talk history and the home work links. No reference block draws ruled definition-style rows.

variants.rationale: Home: four linked work rows with a one-line note each.
28 articles: kind (Article, Talk, Video) + title + note.
Talks page: date column, title, event and place, links to recordings and write-ups.

name: author-box
description: Closing author card: initials avatar, name, role line, three profile links.
rationale: 28/28 articles with identical copy; a candidate for a shared fragment so one edit updates every article.

variants.rationale: 28/28 articles with identical copy; a candidate for a shared fragment so one edit updates every article.

name: rail
description: Sticky right rail on articles: On this page, a progress bar, numbered part links (some with 72x46 thumbnails), and links to the video and source.
rationale: 28/28 articles. The part titles are shorter than the H2s and the thumbnails are chosen per part, so the rows are authored; the progress bar and the current-part state are code.

variants.rationale: 28/28 articles. The part titles are shorter than the H2s and the thumbnails are chosen per part, so the rows are authored; the progress bar and the current-part state are code.

name: figure
description: Framed figure: an image (hand-drawn board, slide or diagram) with a caption; shot is a narrower screenshot with a soft drop shadow.
rationale: 92 figures on 25 articles. Default-content images would lose the frame, caption rule and zoom; neither reference library has a captioned figure.

variants.rationale: 83 instances: boards, slides and diagrams at xwide or wide width.
9 instances on 3 articles: product screenshots, some shot--narrow.

name: video
description: YouTube nocookie embed in a 16:9 frame with a caption linking to YouTube.
rationale: 20 embeds on 19 pages. The Block Collection video/embed block covers YouTube; parity needs the caption figure and the nocookie host.

variants.rationale: 20 embeds on 19 pages. The Block Collection video/embed block covers YouTube; parity needs the caption figure and the nocookie host.

name: code
description: Dark code block (Night 850 ground, 14px radius) with line numbers, token colors and an optional caption; static, wrap and prose variants by class.
rationale: 45 blocks on 18 articles. Tokens are pre-highlighted spans (tk-k, tk-s, tk-n, tk-c) in the source; the migration needs either authored code with client highlighting or the spans carried as HTML, an implementer decision.

variants.rationale: 45 blocks on 18 articles. Tokens are pre-highlighted spans (tk-k, tk-s, tk-n, tk-c) in the source; the migration needs either authored code with client highlighting or the spans carried as HTML, an implementer decision.

name: lab
description: Interactive explainer frame: a mono bar (what it models + a source link) over a two-column grid of controls and readout.
rationale: 30 labs on 13 articles. The frame is shared; what runs inside is per article (state machines, token labs, gates), which is the explainer question.

variants.rationale: 30 labs on 13 articles. The frame is shared; what runs inside is per article (state machines, token labs, gates), which is the explainer question.

name: compare
description: Tabbed before/after or side-by-side panes.
rationale: 5 articles. Tabs from the Block Collection give the tablist; the panes and the stage are site CSS.

variants.rationale: 5 articles. Tabs from the Block Collection give the tablist; the panes and the stage are site CSS.

name: data-table
description: Captioned data table in a scrolling wrap: mono uppercase headers over a strong rule, first column in Ink.
rationale: 14 tables on 9 articles. Block Collection table builds the table from rows; parity needs the caption, the 36rem minimum and the scroll wrap.

variants.rationale: 14 tables on 9 articles. Block Collection table builds the table from rows; parity needs the caption, the 36rem minimum and the scroll wrap.
2 wide tables in a horizontal scroller.

name: chips
description: Row of mono chips with a dot.
rationale: 2 standalone instances; most chips live inside labs and explainers.

variants.rationale: 2 standalone instances; most chips live inside labs and explainers.

rationale: 32 root instances on 21 articles plus the labs; 26 articles ship a local explainer.css and most a script. One block name with one variant per explainer keeps the catalog honest; whether each variant is a block with authored rows or a code-only widget is open question explainer-build.

name: jump-links
description: Portfolio in-page jump links to the project chapters.
rationale: Portfolio only, five links.

variants.rationale: Portfolio only, five links.

name: timeline
description: Time-based structures: the portfolio Gantt of projects over time, the release ladder (versions on a rail) and the career milestones.
rationale: Portfolio (3) plus ladders inside two article labs. The canon timeline (release ladder) is one variant; the Gantt is drawn from data rows.

variants.rationale: Projects over time: rows of bars on a year scale with a now marker and a method legend.
Continuous Executive Agent release history: eras and rungs.
Career notes milestone list.

name: divider
description: Labeled divider between portfolio chapters (mono label between hairlines); the year variant is the large outlined year numeral.
rationale: 11 on the portfolio. A plain hr loses the label; section metadata could carry it, but the label is content, so a small block.

variants.rationale: 11 on the portfolio. A plain hr loses the label; section metadata could carry it, but the label is content, so a small block.
One year band (2025).

name: chapter-head
description: Project chapter opening: outlined numeral, title with italic subtitle, mono meta and method line, thesis, optional arc and facts.
rationale: 11 chapters on the portfolio; the Anima Mesh chapter carries class flagship (larger title), two chapters class lofi. Variants flagship and lofi are classes on the chapter, not split by the parser.

variants.rationale: 11 chapters on the portfolio; the Anima Mesh chapter carries class flagship (larger title), two chapters class lofi. Variants flagship and lofi are classes on the chapter, not split by the parser.

rationale: Home work feature and portfolio stories (frame--diagram, diagram-frame, portrait in the DOM). Kept apart from figure because the portfolio frame has the diagram-ground and link-to-full-size rules.

variants.rationale: Home work feature and portfolio stories (frame--diagram, diagram-frame, portrait in the DOM). Kept apart from figure because the portfolio frame has the diagram-ground and link-to-full-size rules.

rationale: Portfolio Anima Mesh, one instance with six panes.

variants.rationale: Toolbar label and position counter above the tabs.

description: Chapter-closing panel (edge): a heading and a grid of short approaches or a roadmap note.
rationale: 2 on the portfolio. The canon's panel--inverse appears on none of the 34 pages.

variants.rationale: Edge grid with a closing line.

description: Wrapping row of evidence chips, the value bold in the band accent.
rationale: 2 on the portfolio, nested in stories.

variants.rationale: 2 on the portfolio, nested in stories.

description: Counter row of block stat values (lifetime figures).
rationale: 1 on the portfolio; values are in the HTML, a script may count them up.

description: Three-slide image carousel with controls and a count.
rationale: Shadow Pivot chapter, one instance (slides load lazily).

variants.rationale: Shadow Pivot chapter, one instance (slides load lazily).

name: cards
description: Grid of compact tool cards, each card itself a link to a repo.
rationale: Portfolio Smaller repos: 7 tool cards. Boilerplate cards plus the tool variant (the card is the link, repo mark, mono title).

variants.rationale: The one card whose element is the link.

name: writing-filter
description: Writing index filter bar: topic and year filter pills with counts and a search field (GET ?q=).
rationale: Configuration only, everything else comes from the index and user input: a widget.

variants.rationale: Configuration only, everything else comes from the index and user input: a widget.

name: writing-list
description: Writing index rows: cover, date, title, summary, tags, facts; 28 rows today.
rationale: Authored by hand on the source; on EDS it renders from the query index so a new article lists itself.

variants.rationale: Authored by hand on the source; on EDS it renders from the query index so a new article lists itself.

name: facts
description: Article facts paragraph (first published, rewritten, skill or repo version) in the label voice.
rationale: On 28 articles as p.article-facts. The parser reads a paragraph as default content, so page-blocks never places it and blocks.json shows 0; reach is the facts signal in implementation.json. Authors cannot class a paragraph in EDS, so parity needs a block (or an auto-block rule).

name: chapters
description: Watch this part: timestamp links into the article video, one row per part.
rationale: p.watch paragraphs on 17 articles (signal watch). Same parser limit as facts: 0 in blocks.json, measured by signal.

name: proof-links
description: Row of typed links (repo, post, video, live) with masked line icons.
rationale: 3 rows inside portfolio story text; the parser keeps them in the showcase text cell. Typed by destination per the canon.
